text: Decide whether the sentinel ownership scheme should move from the filename to a body field, given that six readers hand-copy the parser and two must stay builtin-only. Write the decision and its trade-offs into DECISIONS.md.

The holdout suite and the in-repo shell suite disagree on whether a verdict row with empty evidence may be recorded. Determine which one encodes the charter correctly and propose the fix for the other.
Review the base-gate arm 3 design: it judges the merged tree against the base floors. Identify every way a PR could lower a floor without arm 3 going red, and rank them by exploitability.
Design how the Stop hook's loop guard should interact with a sibling plugin that also blocks Stop, so neither can disarm the other. Produce the invariant set and the failure each one prevents.
Choose between byte caps and line caps for the ledger reader, given NUL bytes are discarded by read and a single 2 MB line hung the scan. Justify with the measured cases.
Audit the six validator pins added in 0.11.9 for vacuity: for each, decide whether its mutation actually goes red in the gate it names, and say which are hypotheses.
Implement --target on ops-verdict.sh: parse the flag, thread it into the row key the cap detector reads, keep the 4-cell row shape, and add red-first cases to tests/test-scripts.sh.
Strip the whole trailing CR run (bounded by CAPS_MAX_CR) in ops-reverify.sh's row parser, matching lib/caps.sh's loop, and add the \r\r\n case with its LF control.
Add a --json output mode to ops-tiers.sh that emits the resolved tier-to-model map, keeping the text mode byte-identical, with cases for both modes and an unknown tier.
Make scan_caps cache its result keyed on the ledger's content hash plus the lib's own bytes, falling back to a full scan on any cache failure, with a same-size FAIL-to-PASS edit case.
Add the spec Status gate to workflows/plan.js: read the column-0 Status line, require first-token APPROVED, refuse before any dispatch, and cover NOT-APPROVED and a missing line in the node suite.
Port the MALFORMED bucket from scan_pending into statusline.sh's BLOCKING count so the bar and the Stop hook agree, and add the case where only a malformed sentinel is pending.
Add ops-backlog.sh to the _OPS_TOOLS literal in scripts/ops-install-set.sh and bump the two tests that count the install set from 6 to 7.
Bump plugin.json version to 0.12.14 and add a matching '## [0.12.14]' heading as the newest entry in CHANGELOG.md with the provided release notes.
Run the five gate-suite rungs (validator, python, shell, workflows, compress) one after another and report each completion marker line verbatim.
Rename the label 'lens:provider' to 'lens:providers' in workflows/review.js and in the one test assertion in tests/test_workflows.mjs that names it.
Raise FLOOR_SHELL in tests/floors.env from 1386 to 1420 to match the suite's current passed+skipped count.
Create tests/fixtures/crlf-ledger.md with exactly the three rows given below, CRLF line endings, no trailing newline.
Find every file in the repo that references CAPS_MAX_CR and report the paths and line numbers.
List every agentType string used across workflows/*.js and which workflow uses each.
Locate where ops-sessionstart-hook.sh wipes .autobar/ and .stopguard/, and quote the lines.
Report which GitHub issues are still open with the label 'blocked', with their titles.
Find the case titles in tests/test-scripts.sh that mention F136 and print them.
Which scripts under scripts/ source lib/partition.sh? List them.
